hooks.name: Detection change test reminder
hooks.description: When a detection or response engine file is saved, reminds the agent to honor Sentinel's testing constraints: every Tier1 rule needs a test that it fires as Tier1Behavioral, every Tier2 rule a test that it returns Tier2Indicator, the Tier2 log-only contract must be verified, and any new proactive host mutation must ship a ProductPosture default-deny test.

action.prompt: A detection/response-related file was just changed. Before considering this done, verify Sentinel's testing constraints from docs/constraints.md are met: (1) every new/changed Tier1 rule has a test proving it fires and returns Tier1Behavioral; (2) every Tier2 rule has a test proving it returns Tier2Indicator; (3) the Tier2 log-only contract still holds (Tier2 with ActiveResponse=true must still be LogOnly); (4) any new proactive host mutation gates on ProductPosture and ships a default-deny test. Add or update tests as needed, then run the suite.
